[[File:Fire-eaters.png|thumb|right|200px|The Fire-eaters]]
The '''Fire-eaters''' were a gang of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] criminals who were imprisoned in [[Belsavis prison]] prior to the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]]. They were led by [[Kazzak Hurn]], and incarcerated in [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis's]] [[High Security Section]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|Fire Eater Mutiny|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>
